{{Quote|Hold up there friends, what brings you to the Landing?|[[Gall (individual)|Gall]], to Lady Wylla's agents|<ref name="Death, Dirt, and the Nerf Rancher's Daughter">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20011018a|text=Death, Dirt, and the Nerf Rancher's Daughter|int=Death, Dirt, and the Nerf Rancher's Daughter}}</ref>}}
The '''Landing''' was the sole settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Engebo V]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The settlement was established by the [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company]] as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] installation and for a [[Time/Legends|time]], it prospered. However, a few centuries later, the planet's mineral deposits eventually dried up and Outer Rim Oreworks abandoned the Landing and Engebo V. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] entrpreneur [[Jaffro Davengatt]] subsequently established [[Davengatt's Double-Zed Nerf Ranch]] in the Landing, a farm that produced high-quality [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] meat.

At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Wylla]] sent a group of agents to the Landing, to purchase some [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerf steaks]]. However, shortly afterward the Landing became infested with [[skekfish]], which [[Death/Legends|killed]] most of the settlement's population.
